items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Oh, that Albert Nicholas was a good clarinet player! And he had a wonderful clarinet tone.

ctx.x: And then when Artie passed out the picture, when I heard him speak on the air one night about, well, you know, it's not so great being number two...
